posting.title: Head of Data Science
posting.description:
About the role:
Meridian Health Analytics builds predictive models for hospital resource planning across Danish and Swedish hospitals. We are hiring a Head of Data Science to build and lead our data science function.

Responsibilities:
You will define the data science strategy, build ML pipelines for patient-flow forecasting using Python and Spark, and manage a growing team of data scientists. You will work closely with engineering and clinical stakeholders.

Requirements:
7+ years of experience in data science, including experience leading a team, is required. Strong hands-on experience with Python (scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas), SQL, AWS, and Spark is required.

Compensation:
The salary for this position is 750,000-850,000 DKK per year, depending on experience, plus a pension contribution and annual bonus.

Location and work mode:
Hybrid role based in our Copenhagen office, three days a week on-site.

What we offer:
A mission-driven team working on healthcare capacity planning, and a generous professional-development budget.
